subject: REJECT Gen7 Core V1 unchanged: adversarial model exposes contract violations
body: Independent review of Primary Gen7 Core Dev Round V1 at current main 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. Primary stock harness independently reruns PASS, but a Manager adversarial harness against the exact artifact reproduces 7 contract gaps. Highest-confidence blockers: (1) cross-gap first reacquired trusted sample is simultaneously classified reversal=true, and REVERSAL_GUARD wins over REACQUIRE; this directly corroborates the 17:51:39Z reversal/reacquisition HOF. (2) TrustedMeasurement accepts sourceTimeNs>deliveryTimeNs (negative source age). (3) readiness ledger accepts time-regressing FIRST_USEFUL after later-time FIRST_PRESENTED when frame sequence increases. (4) advanceGeneration() is not represented in PresentationHinge frame API, so the pure core cannot itself fence stale same-attempt generation callbacks. (5) targetForFrame parameter is named expectedPresentationTimeNs but implementation adds PIPELINE_LEAD_NS again; if caller supplies the directive-defined targetPresentationTime=expectedVsync+lead, lead is doubled. Additional gaps: refresh lease acquire overwrites active lease without explicit old-release/supersession accounting; directive-required bounded acceleration/jerk and critically damped reacquire correction are not yet implemented. Disposition: REJECT current V1 unchanged as an integration/promotion candidate; retain the semantic/presentation architecture and revise the pure core before Android wiring. No production writes. Device validation remains required after revision/integration.
independent_revalidation: stock harness PASS; manager adversarial harness reproduces 7/7 targeted contract gaps
contradiction_status: No contradiction with Gen7 semantic/presentation split. Cross-gap finding corroborates current research HOF; revision is implementation-level.
